column1: UI guide: step by step for each person
The same pages run on Azure, locally and in the desktop app. Screenshots: docs/evidence in the repository.

column4: Open the UI address. Read what the platform does; download the desktop app for macOS or Windows if you want it; select Sign in.
Enter the username and password the admin gave you, then sign in. Change the temporary password on /account.
Enter the model endpoint, model name and key; select Test connection; tick the models people may use; grant plugins to roles.
Add user: username, temporary password, email and role (qe_lead, ba, developer or viewer).
Choose who may sign gates G0 to G5. Agents never sign.
Create a project, then attach a repository: upload a zip or paste a GitHub URL. Add Members who may see it.

Type a request, or '/' to pick a command or skill (for example /agentic-qe:qe-start <app>). Watch the status lines; approve or reject each file write and shell command on its card. A plugin command stays active until you send another; to resume it, send the same command again.
column5: Answer, todos and written files appear; each write shows the command's check result.

column4: Write or generate requirements documents (BRD) and Gherkin; every save is a new version with history. Sign gate G1 when ready.
Run the QE cycle gate by gate (G0 to G5). Each gate needs its check to pass and a named person to sign.
column5: Gate shows signed with name, role and time.

column4: Run a bug scan and review findings; generated changes land on a separate branch, shown as a diff.
Approve or reject pending items; review the hash-chained ledger.
Choose source and kind, write the request, review the plan, approve, generate, test (Repair from test failures if needed), evaluate, publish.
column5: Skill listed on /skills with a version.

column4: Add a remote (HTTP) MCP server, Connect, then grant each tool to roles. stdio servers run only in the desktop app.
See the governed agents and their evaluation scores (n and judge, or why blank).
Open a run to see its span tree and timings.
Check token use per person and model; set allowances.
Change your own password and email.
Install PostgreSQL 16+ first; install the DMG (right-click, Open the first time) or the MSI (SmartScreen: More info, Run anyway). It runs its own API, UI and local database.
column5: Same pages as the web app, plus stdio MCP and plugin installs.
